conclusions.rationale: On the first event the integrand is at most epsilon, and on the second it is at most one. Thus limsup E|X_n| <= epsilon for every epsilon>0, and nonnegativity proves the limit.
conclusions.repair: No repair is needed. Convergence almost surely is not required.
